description: Stop wasting time with annoying soap dispensers that require two hands to operate just to prevent them from toppling over into your sink…
Introducing the Joey Soap Dispenser with Built-In Storage from Umbra
Designed to be sturdy, Joey is made with a heavier matte ceramic that keeps it in place while allowing you to easily dispense liquid soap or lotion (foaming soap not recommended) with a single hand.

In the kitchen, Joey’s built-in storage compartment keeps the included scrubby, or your favorite sponge, neat and accessible. In the bathroom, the built-in compartment can be used to store hair elastics, bobby pins, hair clips or even dental floss - keeping your countertop clutter free.
Featuring a generous 20 oz fill capacity, Joey measures 4 x 5 x 8 inches, allowing it to take up minimal space on your countertop without constant refilling.
For a sturdy and reliable kitchen soap dispenser that features built-in storage and a 20 oz fill capacity order Joey from Umbra today.
